posts.name: McBehrer
posts.cooked:
Iron Legacy is quite possibly the single hardest villain to beat in the game. Sometimes I've played games where he takes each hero down to half health in the first villain turn.

 

Miss Information is not a 2; no way in hell. She's at least a solid 3.

 

Kismet is a low 2, but with the right combination of cards (Karmic Disjunction, Lady Luck, and Inconceivable Obstruction) she can pack quite a wallop.

 

La Capitan can be pretty hard. Her crew is all very powerful and annoying, and especially on advanced she takes a while to whittle her health down.

 

Dreamer is probably a 3. Some of her projections are downright brutal, and you can't even START to win until you clear the board, which can take a while with certain setups.

posts.cooked:
McBehrer:

Iron Legacy is quite possibly the single hardest villain to beat in the game.

People have been saying that, but I'm not sure. I'd really like him to be the hardest villain to date. Maybe it's because I played early builds of him and haven't played the final build, but The Organization still seemed like the harder foe. But I'm not denying he's really challenging. His advanced mode certainly is the most difficult thing ever.

Chances are once I get my hard copy of ST and play the final build of Iron Legacy, I'll come back here and agree with everyone that he's the hardest. I mean, I could do it now, but I don't feel like printing the cards again and such. I'd rather wait.
